# GENERATED by tools/gen/gen_ck3_mod.mjs - do not edit by hand.
# Per-side snapshot records (docs/PROTOCOL.md 1.2): S, then A (+AX, R, RX) per army, then C (+CX) per character.
# Inputs: bridge/data/*.json and the CK3 install. Regenerate: node tools/gen/gen_ck3_mod.mjs

# this = combat. Needs the snapshot scopes (scope:ck3xbl_bid, scope:ck3xbl_my_side_code, ...).
ck3xbl_emit_side_att_effect = {
	combat_attacker = {
		save_scope_as = ck3xbl_side
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_side_code value = 1 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_s_size value = side_army_size }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_s_has_primary value = 0 }
		side_primary_participant ?= {
			save_scope_as = ck3xbl_s_primary
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_s_has_primary value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { ck3xbl_side_has_player_trigger = yes AND = { scope:ck3xbl_player_present = 1 scope:ck3xbl_my_side_code = 1 } } }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_s_player_in value = 1 }
		}
		else = { save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_s_player_in value = 0 } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_s_has_cmd value = 0 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_s_hostility_out value = 0 }
		side_commander ?= {
			save_scope_as = ck3xbl_s_cmd
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_s_has_cmd value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:ck3xbl_s_has_cmd = 0 }
			combat = {
				location = {
					ordered_army_in_location = {
						limit = { is_army_in_combat = yes involved_combat_side = { this = scope:ck3xbl_side } exists = army_commander }
						order_by = army_size
						army_commander = {
							save_scope_as = ck3xbl_s_cmd
							save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_s_has_cmd value = 1 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:ck3xbl_s_has_cmd = 1 }
			scope:ck3xbl_s_cmd.faith = { save_scope_as = ck3xbl_s_my_faith }
			enemy_side = {
				side_commander ?= {
					save_temporary_scope_as = ck3xbl_s_enemy_cmd
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:ck3xbl_s_enemy_cmd } }
				combat = {
					location = {
						ordered_army_in_location = {
							limit = { is_army_in_combat = yes involved_combat_side = { NOT = { this = scope:ck3xbl_side } } exists = army_commander }
							order_by = army_size
							army_commander = {
								save_temporary_scope_as = ck3xbl_s_enemy_cmd
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			scope:ck3xbl_s_enemy_cmd ?= {
				faith = { save_scope_as = ck3xbl_s_enemy_faith }
				scope:ck3xbl_s_my_faith = {
					if = { limit = { faith_hostility_level = { target = scope:ck3xbl_s_enemy_faith value >= 3 } } save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_s_hostility_out value = 3 } }
					else_if = { limit = { faith_hostility_level = { target = scope:ck3xbl_s_enemy_faith value >= 2 } } save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_s_hostility_out value = 2 } }
					else_if = { limit = { faith_hostility_level = { target = scope:ck3xbl_s_enemy_faith value >= 1 } } save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_s_hostility_out value = 1 } }
				}
				clear_saved_scope = ck3xbl_s_enemy_faith
			}
			if = { limit = { exists = scope:ck3xbl_s_enemy_cmd } clear_saved_scope = ck3xbl_s_enemy_cmd }
			clear_saved_scope = ck3xbl_s_my_faith
		}
		info_log = "CK3XBL|S|att"
		info_log_scopes = yes
	}
	location = {
		# armies with their men-at-arms regiments
		every_army_in_location = {
			limit = { ck3xbl_army_in_combat_side_trigger = { ATT = yes } }
			ck3xbl_tag_army_effect = yes
			ck3xbl_save_army_values_effect = yes
			army_owner = { ck3xbl_save_knight_eff_effect = yes }
			info_log = "CK3XBL|A|att"
			info_log_scopes = yes
			clear_saved_scope = ck3xbl_a_ke
			ck3xbl_emit_ax_army_effect = yes
			army_owner = { ck3xbl_emit_ax_effect = yes }
			ck3xbl_emit_regiments_effect = yes
		}
		# army commanders
		every_army_in_location = {
			limit = { ck3xbl_army_in_combat_side_trigger = { ATT = yes } }
			army_commander ?= {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { ck3xbl_char_emitted_trigger = yes } }
					ck3xbl_save_char_values_effect = yes
					info_log = "CK3XBL|C|CMD|att"
					info_log_scopes = yes
					ck3xbl_emit_cx_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	combat_attacker = {
		every_side_knight = {
			limit = { NOT = { ck3xbl_char_emitted_trigger = yes } }
			ck3xbl_save_char_values_effect = yes
			info_log = "CK3XBL|C|KNIGHT|att"
			info_log_scopes = yes
			ck3xbl_emit_cx_effect = yes
		}
		side_primary_participant ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { ck3xbl_char_emitted_trigger = yes } }
				ck3xbl_save_char_values_effect = yes
				info_log = "CK3XBL|C|PRIMARY|att"
				info_log_scopes = yes
				ck3xbl_emit_cx_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
	# the player, on the side the player belongs to, unless already listed
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:ck3xbl_player scope:ck3xbl_my_side_code = 1 }
		scope:ck3xbl_player = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { ck3xbl_char_emitted_trigger = yes } }
				ck3xbl_save_char_values_effect = yes
				info_log = "CK3XBL|C|PLAYER|att"
				info_log_scopes = yes
				ck3xbl_emit_cx_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
